title: JPMorgan Stock Rises 0.7% as Bank Calls for S&P 8,000 - Yahoo Finance
text: JPMorgan Stock Rises 0.7% as Bank Calls for S&P 8,000 Khac Phu Nguyen August 13, 2026 2 min read JPM ^GSPC This article first appeared on GuruFocus . JPMorgan Chase ( NYSE:JPM ), America's largest bank by assets, rose approximately 0.7% Wednesday morning as its strategy team turned even more bullish on stocks. The bank now sees the S&P 500 ( SPY ) ending 2026 at 8,000, up from its previous 7,800 target. That grabs the headline. But the real story is earnings. JPMorgan is effectively saying this rally does not need to survive on hype and higher valuations alone. AI spending is exploding, cloud growth is accelerating, and corporate profits are giving bulls something much harder to argue with. Warning! GuruFocus has detected 8 Warning Sign with JPM. Is JPM fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator. The numbers back that up. JPMorgan lifted its 2026 S&P 500 earnings forecast to $365 per share from $350 and jacked its 2027 estimate to $420 from $390. According to Reuters, the bank sees stronger cloud demand, bigger AI backlogs and growing evidence that hyperscalers are finally turning enormous AI infrastructure budgets into actual revenue. And earnings season is delivering. Of the 436 S&P 500 companies that had reported through the previous Friday, 85.1% beat earnings expectations, based on LSEG data cited by Reuters. That matters. The AI trade has spent years selling the future. JPMorgan thinks more of that future is now hitting the income statement. Here is the part investors should not miss. JPMorgan raised its 2026 earnings estimate by roughly 4.3%, but lifted its S&P 500 target by only about 2.6%. Translation: earnings are expected to do the heavy lifting. The bank is still working with a forward multiple near 20 times, leaving interest rates, geopolitics and heavy securities issuance as obvious pressure points. JPMorgan Stock Rises 0.7% as Bank Calls for S&P 8,000 · us.finance.gurufocus JPMorgan's own valuation tells a similar story. The stock traded at $364.78 on Aug. 12 versus a GF Value of $311.77, putting the shares roughly 17% above GF Value. That is not bargain territory. The market is already pricing in plenty of strength. If the S&P 500 really charges toward 8,000, JPMorgan could win from hotter trading, investment banking and asset-management activity. But with the stock already carrying a premium, the message is simple: the earnings now have to deliver. Terms and Privacy Policy Privacy Dashboard More Info
